reviewer: consumer-only audio-rights remediation: removed the bundled mixture dependency and retained only user-supplied audio

rubric.evidence: The committed route-complete validator attaches a validator-generated two-source WAV to the real file input and runs welcomyou/convtasnet-libri2mix-16k-onnx in headless Chrome at desktop and mobile. It requires two finite, non-silent, non-identical output waveforms with the input length.
rubric.notes: The generated validation bytes are temporary test data and are never bundled or offered in the product UI.

rubric.evidence: The worker sends mixture [1, samples] float32 mono 16 kHz into ONNX Runtime Web and returns sources [1, 2, samples] as two playable waveforms.
rubric.notes: The page states that the model expects exactly two overlapping voices and caps input to six seconds.

rubric.evidence: At-a-glance declares ConvTasNet Libri2Mix 16 kHz, audio-to-audio, onnxruntime-web 1.21, fp32, WASM, exact I/O shapes, size, and CC BY-SA 4.0 model license.
rubric.notes: transformers.js has no speech-separation task, so the ONNX graph is run directly in the family worker.

rubric.evidence: createModelLoader retains explicit Download for an absent model and auto-initialises a validated cached model; no audio inference starts until the visitor chooses a file and presses Separate audio.
rubric.notes: The model cache behavior is unchanged by this consumer-only remediation.

rubric.evidence: The default live status says no audio is selected and explains the next action. File reading, ready-to-run, separating, success, decode failure, and inference failure are visible. The run button is enabled only when both a decoded file and model are ready.
rubric.notes: The page does not silently fetch a media fixture or claim an automatic run.

rubric.evidence: A native labelled file input accepts local audio, drag-and-drop is additive, and a native Separate audio button provides an explicit user action. The mixture and both outputs use native audio controls.
The product has no bundled two-speaker recording and no authored output. Visible output players are populated only from the worker's real ONNX result for visitor-supplied bytes.
rubric.notes: The validator's lawful synthetic waveform exists only in a temporary directory during validation and is not presented to visitors.

rubric.evidence: The upload uses a native input with a visible label and described instructions; the explicit native button has a 44px minimum target; state is a polite live region; errors set aria-invalid; waveforms have text alternatives and audio uses native controls.
rubric.notes: The default instructions explicitly say camera and microphone permission are not requested, leaving a useful upload path when those permissions are absent or denied.

rubric.evidence: Outputs use wrapping flex items with min-inline-size:0 and intrinsic widths. The committed validator checks the full route at 1280x800 and 360x740 with denied audio-capture permission and requires no horizontal overflow.
rubric.notes: DOM order and keyboard order remain identical.

rubric.evidence: Inference remains in a dedicated module Worker and output buffers transfer to the main thread. Input duration remains capped at six seconds.
rubric.notes: Object URLs are revoked when each player source is replaced.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible file upload dropzone keyboard status error progressive enhancement
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer native controls and labels, connect help text, keep focus visible, use restrained live regions, and expose media alternatives.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: native labelled file input and button replace the simulated button dropzone; instructions are linked with aria-describedby; status is polite; canvas and audio outputs are named.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: models/speech-separation/index.html uploadHelp, file, separateBtn, status, and labelled output elements

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive audio controls mobile horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use flex-wrap, intrinsic sizing, min-inline-size:0 for shrinking flex items, safe alignment, and 100% rather than viewport widths.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied to the input/output rows and media elements without changing the shared design system.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible file errors after user interaction
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Synchronize visual errors with aria-invalid and connect errors or status text to the input without announcing an error before interaction.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: the input starts valid and aria-invalid is added only after a selected file fails to decode; the described polite status contains the actionable error.

openQuestions: For long recordings, is fixed-window overlap-add sufficient, or is speaker-permutation tracking required across chunks?
followUpGoals: Add a chunking and overlap-add mode for visitor recordings longer than six seconds.
Consider an explicitly user-initiated microphone flow only if its denied-state and cleanup behavior can be validated without weakening upload.
summary: Speech separation retains real on-device ConvTasNet inference while removing every bundled two-speaker media dependency. The useful default is an accessible local-file workflow that requests no camera or microphone permission, gives explicit state and action instructions, and never claims a missing or automatic media run.
